summary.en: Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan reiterated that Beijing could easily win a conflict with the Philippines, prompting PCG spokesperson Rear Admiral Jay Tarriela to label the comment a direct threat. President Marcos pledged a stronger Coast Guard and launched a five-day maritime defence drill along the eastern Mindanao coast. Philippine and US navy and coast guard vessels conducted their 16th bilateral maritime exercise in the West Philippine Sea. Japan began providing modernization support to the Philippine Coast Guard. The UCDP recorded 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kinesisk ambassadør Jing Quan gjentok at Beijing lett kunne vinne en konflikt med Filippinene, noe som fikk den filippinske kystvakten (PCG) sin talsmann, konteradmiral Jay Tarriela, til å betegne kommentaren som en direkte trussel. President Marcos lovet en sterkere kystvakt og igangsatte en fem-dagers maritimt forsvarsøvelse langs den østlige kysten av Mindanao. Filippinske og amerikanske marine‑ og kystvaktskip gjennomførte sin 16. bilaterale maritime øvelse i Vestfilippinske hav. Japan begynte å gi moderniseringsstøtte til den filippinske kystvakten. UCDP registrerte 176 drepte i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
